text: M01 `7yzu5k8u` (and the two ACs) say an unresolvable `config.writingStyle` STOPS the start, with the message telling the cause apart. The code at 2.1.8 deliberately soft-failed in `buildProjectContext` (warn + treat the style as unset) with the stated reason that a thrown per-project build 500s every route of that project, including the Settings endpoints the user needs to pick a valid style. Built per the specification: the project build now throws the verdict's message (`checkWritingStyleAtStart`, src/server/services/writing-style-start.ts). The trade-off the old code recorded (a stale slug after removing a plugin makes the project unopenable until config.json is edited by hand) is not addressed by the specification; if the soft-fail was intended, M01 should say so.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0401 — start-up hard-fail replaces the soft-fail (src/server/workspace/project-context.ts, checkWritingStyleAtStart)
